Southern Wild Duck.o: In Tonga the Cross is drawn as a duck flying south, one wing (Delta Crucis) hurt by a stone that the two men, Alpha and Beta Centauri, threw at it.
Southern Wild Duck.c: Wikipedia, “Crux” (Tonga), after E. E. V. Collocott, Tongan Astronomy and Calendar (Bishop Museum, 1922)

String of fishes.t: Tuinga ika: Part of Orion, belt and sword.

Wild Duck's Point of Land.t: Houmatoloa (Toloa, toloatonga, toloalahi): Listed by Stellarium's description with Toloa, toloatonga, toloalahi.
